tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshe dpag med lha dgu'i sbyin sreg bar chad kun sel bzhugs so// bla ma dang mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir tshe dpag med lha dgu'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ sngags kyi nus pa 'byung zhing lhag chad kha skong ba dang / sdig sgrib zhi ba'i phyir/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ thab khung zlum po khru do pa'i nang du/ kha khyer dang mu ran sor bzhi bskor/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba bri/ phyi rol du stegs bu gru bzhi pa/ zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bya/ gzhi tshon thams cad dkar po/ rdo rje ser po de'i nang du dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sam/ mi nus na padma 'dab brgyad lha dgu'i mtshan ma dang bcas pa bri/ kha khyer gyi steng du bud shing brtsig shar lho'i mtshams su me tshang ting lo bzhag thab kyi nub tu sgrub pa po'i stan dang / mdun du bsang chu 'thor g.yab/ rdor dril/ dgang gzar blugs gzar/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ me yol dkar rtsi byugs pa dang / sgrub pa po'i g.yas nas/ yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / /'bras dang so ba nas sran ma/ /gro dang dur ba ku sha ste/ /g.yon nas chu gnyis nyer mchod lnga/ /de'i phyi ru 'das gtor dang / /rgyal chen cha gsum me lha yi/ /gtor ma rnams ni rim bzhin bshams/ /phyi dro'i dus su khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/ 'byor na rgyan gos dkar pos brgyan la/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi mdzad pa'i tshe chog 'chi med grub pa'i lam bzang nas byung ba ltar/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas gzhal yas khang rang la thim zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bya/ bsang chu la a mṛ ta nyer gcig gis byin gyis brlabs la/ rdzas rnams la gtor te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che lasagrub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ mchod rdzas rnams dkyil chog bzhin dang /

bsreg rdzas rnams lha mnyes par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bskyed/ so so'i phyag dang bcas arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ rtswa gtsang ma dang bcas pa'i yam shing gi rtse la ras dmar sbags pa'i spos 'des me sbar te/ oṃ agna ye dzwa la raṃ/ zhes brjod cing thab la g.yas nas lan gsum bskor te/ me tshang du bzhugs/ rtswa skam po dang mar khu sogs kyi me gso/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ mu ran la rdo rje phreng bas bskor ba nang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang / bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo dril 'dzin pas/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i drang srong gnyis skyes mchog /sreg blug zhal zas bzhed slad du/ /'di ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod/ /oṃ agna ye ma hā te dza/ sarba karma pra sā da ka ka ru ṇya kṛ ta sarba yasmi sinna hi to bha wa/ zhes spyan drangs/ padma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ gyi gdan phul/ thabs kyi dbus su padma dang ra skyes kyi gdan la 'khod pa ni/ me lha sku mdog dkar po zhal cig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng dang / g.yon ri ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab pa drang srong gi tshogs kyis/ bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ ku sha brgyad bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ thab dang yo byad kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin/ /des bdag la bgegs med cing zhe bar mdzod gcig swā hā/ /zhes dang / oṃ badzra sa twa a/

zhes pas thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas bskor du dbul/ me lha'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas/ dgang blugs kyi raṃ la phog nas mar khu gsol bar bsam zhing / oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes pa lan bdun gyi mthar/ dgang blugs kha sbyar la/ oṃ yagna ye/ ā dī pya/ ā dī pya/ ā bi ṣa/ mahā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha nā ya swā hā/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon skyems phul/ oṃ agna ye sa pa re wa ra mgor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer mchod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshang dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur zhing / /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ bsreg rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas bzung la/ g.yas pas steng nas blangs zhing mchog sbyin gi phyag rgyas dbul te/ oṃ bo dhi brikṣā ya swā hā/ yam shing / oṃ agna ye swā hā/ mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ya swā hā/ til/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zas mchog oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badzra bi dza ye swā hā/ so ba/ oṃ badzra be gā ya swā hā/ nas/ oṃ badzra ma hā bā la swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badzra ghasma rā ya swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swā hā/ dur ba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swā hā/ ku sha rnams nyer gcig re phul/ gong ltar mchod bstod bya/ mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ agna ye dzwa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thab kyi dbus su/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa'am/ padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du hriḥdamar po re re sogs nas/ gtso 'khor thams cad la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar dkyil chog gi mdun bskyed ltar ro/

/gtso bo dang bla ma tha mi dad pa la sangs rgyas dang byas chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ sngags gsum sbrel ba tshar gcig gi rjes su/ agna ye lan bdun gyi mthar dgang blugs kha sbyar te/ ā dī pya sogs dang / bdag gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang / gsang sngags kyi lhag chad thams cad shintaṃ ku ru swāhā/ de lta bu lan gsum/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs sogs nas/ tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo'i bar dkyil chog bzhin/ sngags gsum tshar gcig gi mthar bsreg rdzas so so'i sngags gong gi spel tshig dang bcas brgya rtsa sogs phul/ sdig pa sbyang ba dang / sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba'i don du/ til mdun du gzhag la/ rang gi snying ga'i sdig pa'i sa bon kaṃ yig nag po/ de la tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad 'dus/ lte ba'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas sdig pa thams cad ded de sna sgo nas kaṃ yig gi rnam pas 'thon nas mdun gyi til la thim/ de'i steng du a yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer byung nas til la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa lha rnams la phul bar bsam zhing / gang la bsnyen pa song ba'i sngags kyi bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dbul te/ snying po la 'bru 'bum 'bum phrag bcu bzhi mdzad pas/ 'dir bcu cha la khri tsho bcu bzhi 'bul dgos/ des rigs 'gre/ gang ltar brgya rtsa re'i mjug tu spel tshig gi gong ltar brjod/ me rgyun mi 'chad pa sogs rgyu mtshan zhib par spyi 'gro ltar ro/ /mthar mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rigs/ dkyil chog nas 'byung ba bzhin gyis gtor ma btang / sngar byon skyems kyi skabs ltar dgang blugs gsum gyi gshegs skyems 'bul mchod bstod 'dod don zhus/ thab kyi thal ba cung zad srin lag gis blangs te 'bru gsum brjod cing / gnas gsum du thig le byas pas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/

rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba sogs/ oṃ khyed kyi sogs nas/ oṃbadzra muḥye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ mar blug gzar gang thab tu blugs/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam par gyur/ mchod bstod bya/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rdzas so so'i sngags kyis lan bdun sogs ci rigs phul/ byon skyems ltar gshegs skyems phul la mchod bstod bya/ me lha'i gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ 'bru gsum lan gsum/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra'i mthar nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas dbul/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /zhes sogs kyi mthar 'dod don zhus la/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs dang / bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sgrubs kyi bzhud cig byin za khyod/ ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wa ra gatstsha/ 'dir tshigs bcad bzhi mi gsal/ nas bsngo smon bkra shis bya/ de ltar thun gnyis gsum bzhi gang mos kyi bsnyen pa'i grangs kyi bcu cha'i kha skong nam 'grig par byas la grol mtshams snga dro gcig la bya/ yo byad rnams bsdu/ me mnal ba na thal ba rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung la sogs par dor ro/ /de ltar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sngon du song nas/ lha 'di rgyas pa'i lha yin pas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg byed na mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams ngag las btsal lo/ /zhes pa 'di ni don gnyer rab tu mang pos bskul ba'i ngor dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa dge legs 'phel/ /maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i sbyin sreg bar chad kun sel/
